text:
cs-alex: Heads up — OmniPay (customer) reporting 5-10x token latency and intermittent 403 auth errors since ~09:14 UTC. They say requests from EU are being served out of us-west. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/9872. Sample request IDs: rp_8a3f..., rp_8a4d... Can SRE pls triage? cc @sre-oliver @eng-mia
ops-bot: ALERT: routing-anomaly detector triggered. metric: region_mismatch_rate (eu-west->us-west) = 3.2% (+2.9 sigma). avg p99 latency for omniapi-route = 1.2s -> 9.6s.
cs-alex: adding snippets from customer headers: 
```
> X-Client-Region: eu-west-1
> X-Request-ID: rp_8a3f...\nResponse headers:\n> X-Served-Region: us-west-2
> x-auth-error: token_region_mismatch
```
sre-oliver: ack. Noted correlation with routing mismatch. Did we change any failover or routing TTLs overnight? Asking networking and control-plane.
eng-mia: I deployed a control-plane change at 03:07 UTC to flip default routing TTL for quicker failovers (60s -> 7d) — this was intended to reduce thrash but I accidentally flipped the sign in the env var = effectively set long sticky TTL. Working on a quick check.
net-raj: Also seeing elevated stickiness on load-balancer side for route-group omniapi. Cookie TTL is high; healthchecks are green though. If control-plane now returns long TTL, LB will keep sending to same backend (us-west).
jon-product: FYI we started a canary for the new failover policy at 03:00 UTC for 10% traffic. That could be the vector.
sre-oliver: Ok plan: 1) revert default routing TTL to 60s in control plane, 2) purge routing-cache for affected tenant OmniPay, 3) route OmniPay to dedicated eu pool while we stabilize, 4) rollback canary if needed. Can someone run the admin push?
eng-mia: prepping revert PR now. quick admin commands: 
```
# set default routing ttl back
POST /admin/config/routing ttl=60
# purge cache for tenant
POST /admin/cache/purge {"tenant":"omnipay"}
# promote route to dedicated eu pool
POST /admin/routes/assign {"tenant":"omnipay","pool":"eu-dedicated-01"}
```
net-raj: I'm running the LB cookie reset and forcing DNS weighted routing back to eu. Will update when done.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: rolled back control-plane config version v2026.03.07-rc -> v2026.03.06 at 09:32 UTC (initiated by eng-mia).
sre-oliver: Executed cache purge for tenant=omnipay at 09:33 UTC. Forcing routing TTL override for tenant to 60s.
ops-bot: Metric update @09:40 UTC — region_mismatch_rate dropped to 0.1%, p99 latency for omniapi-route down to 1.1s.
cs-alex: OmniPay confirm: latency and auth errors cleared on their end as of 09:42 UTC. They asked for RCA and ETA on permanent fix.
eva-sales: Customer extremely relieved, wants postmortem and assurance on SLAs. Holding off billing impacts for now; they flagged a few failed requests that may need credits.
sre-oliver: Quick RCA notes (working draft): 
- Root cause: control-plane deploy accidentally set routing TTL to a very long value (7 days) for default routing, causing clients to be pinned to previously chosen region (us-west) even after health/regional preference changes.
- Contributing: canary rollout at 03:00 increased exposure to the misconfigured behavior for ~10% of traffic and sticky LB cookies meant traffic stayed in us-west.
- Impact: several enterprise customers (OmniPay primary report) saw increased latency and token-region mismatch 403s for ~28 minutes (09:14-09:42 UTC). Some requests could have been billed at higher egress cost due to cross-region serving.
- Detection: routing-anomaly alert triggered. First human ack: 09:20 UTC. Remediation: rollback + cache purge + LB cookie reset.
eng-mia: I've opened PR #4238 to fix TTL handling and added unit tests + an integration test that simulates coordinated LB cookie behavior. Link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/4238
sre-oliver: Action items (owners & due dates):
- eng-mia: merge PR #4238 + deploy control-plane patch (due 2026-03-20)
- net-raj: audit LB cookie TTL interactions across regions + add a k8s job to bump unhealthy cookie detection (due 2026-03-18)
- jon-product: pause/freeze canary rollout tooling until we add canary safety checks for config flips (due 2026-03-19)
- cs-alex & eva-sales: draft customer-facing RCA and credit proposal (due 2026-03-18)
- sre-oliver: add routing TTL anomaly alert threshold and automated traffic quarantine for tenants hitting mismatch rate >1% (due 2026-03-22)
support-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-omnipay-1869001111 — used for customer comms and postmortem drafts.
cs-alex: Customer follow-up: Omnipay wants note that we will waive any cross-region overage charges tied to the event. Will coordinate with finance.
sre-oliver: Follow-up checks: will run a 24h synthetic test for omniapi-route region stickiness and report. Also scheduling a mini postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
eng-mia: merging patch now, will monitor. Thanks for quick responses everyone :pray: 
cs-alex: Thanks all — closing the high-urgency channel for now, keeping incident channel open for RCA thread. :white_check_mark:
